capabilities: Attach annotations to specific blocks via ^ai- block references
Resolve, reopen, and explicitly delete annotations
Re-anchor orphaned annotations using stored text quotes
Browse a note's annotations in a sidebar panel
Expose a plugin-method extension point for other plugins to create annotations
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an AI writing tool — it makes no network requests, calls no AI service, and only adds margin annotations.
extras: Gutter markers and the hover affordance work in Live Preview only; Reading view rendering is a deliberate no-op stub planned as a fast-follow. Part of the marioverse plugin suite, with a sample vault (Obsidianverse) for trying it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach a comment to a specific block that survives edits and sync without changing the block's text.

relations.evidence: mirroring the cross-plugin pattern used by Exo's askExo

summary: Block-anchored margin annotations that attach durable, resolvable comments to note blocks without mutating the note's prose.
